question: m15
q: Which of Sydney's commercial centres has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek right now, and which the quietest?

transcript.answer:
**Busiest Friday relative to midweek: Chatswood. Quietest: North Sydney.**

Latest month is September 2026, measured as 3–7pm Opal tap-ons on Friday divided by the Tue–Thu average (1.0 means no Friday dip):

| Centre | Friday gap, Sep 2026 | Jul–Sep 2026 avg | Jan 2020 (pre-COVID) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Chatswood** | **1.030** | 1.015 | 0.944 |
| Strathfield | 1.000 | 0.996 | 1.022 |
| Parramatta | 0.812 | 0.813 | 0.914 |
| Sydney CBD | 0.783 | 0.787 | 0.841 |
| Macquarie Park | 0.770 | 0.765 | 0.921 |
| **North Sydney** | **0.741** | 0.735 | 0.913 |

- **Chatswood** is the only centre where Friday evenings are busier than midweek. It is also above its pre-COVID ratio, having risen 0.086 since January 2020. It was 1.051 in August 2026.
- **North Sydney** has the weakest Friday pattern and is down 0.172 from its pre-COVID level, the largest fall of the six.
- **Strathfield** is essentially flat with midweek on Fridays.

Two caveats. The data is only up to September 2026, so October is not yet included. The source also notes it is unclear whether Sydney Metro taps in the CBD are counted, which may understate CBD levels against 2020. Comparisons between centres within the same period are not affected.
